card.text: Hot A star spinning so fast it is flattened, with hot bright poles and a cooler equator.

sources.label: Ahlers et al. 2020
sources.quote: its local surface brightness to vary by ~38% between its hot poles and cooler equator

introduction.text: KELT-9 is a hot A star about 2.5 times the mass of the Sun. It spins in about 16 hours; its planet KELT-9b crosses over its poles.

sources.label: Ahlers et al. 2020
sources.quote: agreeing with Gaudi et al. (2017) that KELT-9 b is in a nearly polar orbit

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Gaia's colour of the star, brighter and bluer at the poles where its fast spin makes it hotter.
